_description: Gate 3 regression fixture — three sizing scenarios in one BESS project. Covers the full outcome matrix: PASS, INFEASIBLE-but-emitted (P0), and INFEASIBLE-and-empty (WARN).
_reference: BESS v7 Loop 8 failure — Tristan flagged solver declared INFEASIBLE but the PDF showed a complete dimensional layout with rack counts, misleading the founder. Gate 3 was created specifically to catch this pattern.

scenarios.description: Happy path — solver declares feasible, module_dimensions populated. Gate 3 should PASS.

module-battery-racks.count_hint: 16 racks at 32 kWh each = 512 kWh usable

module-pcs-inverter.count_hint: 2 inverter units at 50 kW each = 100 kW AC

scenarios.description: BESS v7 failure pattern — solver declares feasible=false but module_dimensions is still populated with a full layout. Gate 3 must FAIL with severity P0.

module-battery-racks.count_hint: 110 racks at 32 kWh each = 3520 kWh (EXCEEDS ENVELOPE — 66m2 required, 23.5m2 available)

module-pcs-inverter.count_hint: 30 inverter units at 50 kW each = 1500 kW AC

conflicts: SPATIAL INFEASIBLE — battery racks require 66.0m2 floor area but envelope only provides 23.5m2. Target 3500 kWh cannot fit in a single 40ft ISO container. Minimum envelope for this target: 3x40ft ISO or 1x53ft HC with a revised rack layout.
BRIEF UNRESOLVED — target 1500 kW AC requires 30 PCS inverter units but only 6 can fit within the available floor budget.
recommendations: Reduce target to 500 kWh / 100 kW to fit a single 40ft ISO container.
Alternatively, specify a 3x40ft ISO or 53ft HC envelope to accommodate the 3500 kWh target.
If the site has space constraints, consider a split-architecture: 7x500 kWh containers federated under a single power conversion system.
notes: envelope: 40ft ISO container (library default — brief did not specify)
WARN: solver produced module_dimensions despite INFEASIBLE verdict — dimensions are for a layout that CANNOT fit in the declared envelope.

scenarios._note: This is the exact BESS v7 pattern. The engine returned feasible=false but still populated module_dimensions — the layout the PDF rendered as valid was physically impossible.

scenarios.description: Clean solver failure — feasible=false AND module_dimensions is empty. Gate 3 records WARN (not P0) because there is no misleading output.

conflicts: SPATIAL INFEASIBLE — target 3500 kWh requires approximately 66m2 floor area but envelope provides only 23.5m2. No configuration was emitted.
DOMAIN CEILING EXCEEDED — 1500 kW AC exceeds the maximum feasible power density for a single 40ft ISO BESS unit.
recommendations: Specify a larger envelope: 3x40ft ISO federation or a warehouse-bay deployment.
Reduce target to 500 kWh / 100 kW to fit a single 40ft ISO container.
Consider phased deployment: multiple 500 kWh units commissioned over 24 months.
